stage.name: Street Cleaning
stage.description:
Clean up the chaotic and dangerous streets of Kazdel.
<Transverse Plate> Deploying Operators requires the assistance of nearby Operators.

zone.name: You the Constant, You Are Me

flying_boots_elite_mercenary.name: 'Flying Boots' Elite Mercenary
flying_boots_elite_mercenary.flavourText: Mercenaries propelled by compressed air cans beneath their feet. Their favorite targets are Ursus convoys and their simple, durable Ursine products.
abilities: Capable of evading physical attacks. Loses Physical Dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.

pothelm_arbalest.name: 'Pothelm' Arbalest
pothelm_arbalest.flavourText: Well-equipped mercenaries with a Victorian lens on their helms. Thanks to how well their helms block out sound, they have never heard the snickers of other Scar Market mercs behind their backs.

flying_boots_mercenary.name: 'Flying Boots' Mercenary
flying_boots_mercenary.flavourText: Propelled by compressed air cans beneath their feet, 'Flying Boots' mercenaries raid and plunder on the winds.
abilities: Capable of evading physical attacks. Loses Physical Dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.

pothelm_marksman.name: 'Pothelm' Marksman
pothelm_marksman.flavourText: Mercenaries with a Victorian lens on their helms. Thanks to how well their helms block out sound, they have never heard the snickers of other Scar Market mercs behind their backs.

sarkaz_swordsman.name: Sarkaz Swordsman
sarkaz_swordsman.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

scrap_assembler.name: Scrap Assembler
scrap_assembler.flavourText: Mercenaries fascinated with building new equipment and moving heavier equipment by adding more power.
abilities: Temporarily takes flight when blocked or facing a Stabilizer Chain for the first time. DEF is greatly reduced after landing.

scrap_inventor.name: Scrap Inventor
scrap_inventor.flavourText: Inventors who have built a lot of new equipment, but have yet to finish design work on devices for flying and landing.
abilities: Temporarily takes flight when blocked or facing a Stabilizer Chain for the first time. DEF is greatly reduced after landing.

mechanic.name: 'Mechanic'
mechanic.flavourText: Sarkaz artificers who have finally invented a working flying machine, perhaps the predecessor to far more powerful war machines in the distant future.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Attack range reduced when it loses Low-Altitude Hovering.

tinkerer.name: 'Tinkerer'
tinkerer.flavourText: Sarkaz artificers obsessed with building a flying machine. The patches on the balloon mend not just the vehicle, but the heart of a dreamer as well.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Attack range reduced when it loses Low-Altitude Hovering.

bounty_hunter_knight.name: Bounty Hunter 'Knight'
bounty_hunter_knight.flavourText: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, equipped with self-made gear inspired by Kazimierzian knights. They take pleasure in tormenting their targets during missions.
abilities: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

bounty_hunter_grand_knight.name: Bounty Hunter 'Grand Knight'
bounty_hunter_grand_knight.flavourText: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, aspiring to join the Kazimierzian knight competitions once they've saved enough money. For now, their greatest joy remains tormenting their targets as they hunt them down.
abilities: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

enraged_spatula_giant.name: Enraged Spatula Giant
enraged_spatula_giant.flavourText: Mercenaries are adept at building makeshift weapons from whatever is available. This massive, sputtering machine shambles forward, seeking to dice and slice with Lateran kitchen utensils.
abilities: Unblockable
Loses a percentage of HP over time against a Stabilizer Chain.

sarkaz_greatswordsman.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman
sarkaz_greatswordsman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

spatula_giant.name: Spatula Giant
spatula_giant.flavourText: Mercenaries are adept at building makeshift weapons from whatever is available. This massive, sputtering machine shambles forward, brandishing Lateran kitchen utensils while leaking fuel.
abilities: Unblockable
Loses a percentage of HP over time against a Stabilizer Chain.

greater_armored_burdenbeast.name: Greater Armored Burdenbeast
greater_armored_burdenbeast.flavourText: Slow, docile, and even larger, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.
abilities: Will be tripped by a Stabilizer Chain, stunning itself and dealing Physical damage to nearby enemies.

sarkaz_crossbowman.name: Sarkaz Crossbowman
sarkaz_crossbowman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.name: Rogue Mercenary 'Lead Guitar'
rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.flavourText: Metal band members who seamlessly blend their mercenary and performer careers. Their torrential rhythms are powerful enough to melt faces—literally.
abilities: Targets one of your units, continuously dealing Arts and Burn to the target and all Operators connected to that unit by Stabilizer Chains.

weaver.name: 'Weaver'
weaver.flavourText: Mercenaries who expertly wield the latest equipment. Their mastery of the blades is so deep that they can operate a loom with them.
abilities: Attacks also deal splash damage to allied units in 4 adjacent tiles.
Cuts Stabilizer Chains.

armored_burdenbeast.name: Armored Burdenbeast
armored_burdenbeast.flavourText: Large, slow, and docile, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.
abilities: Will be tripped by a Stabilizer Chain, stunning itself and dealing Physical damage to nearby enemies.

rogue_mercenary_bass.name: Rogue Mercenary 'Bass'
rogue_mercenary_bass.flavourText: Agitated rhythms and intense rumbling form the melody of the nomadic city of Kazdel. The members of this metal band have transformed their weapons into musical instruments, blending their dual roles as mercenaries and musicians.
abilities: Targets one of your units, continuously dealing Arts and Burn to the target and all Operators connected to that unit by Stabilizer Chains.
